description: This file defines a Java interface named ContentDao for data access operations related to Content objects within a content management system. It includes method signatures for listing, retrieving, and filtering content based on various attributes such as type, code, language, and store.

classes.name: ContentDao
classes.description: A Java interface extending generic DAO for Content entities, providing methods to retrieve content by type, code, language, and other parameters, with exception handling.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Returns a list of Content objects filtered by a specific ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Returns a list of Content objects filtered by a list of ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its code and store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its code, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Returns a list of Content objects filtered by ContentType and MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Returns a list of Content objects filtered by ContentType and MerchantStore.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects of a certain type, store, and language, excluding non-visible content.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by its ID and Language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription content by store and URL.
